pool.text: Consider two vectors \( \mathbf{v}_1 = \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix} \) and \( \mathbf{v}_2 = \begin{pmatrix} -4 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix} \). What is the dot product \( \mathbf{v}_1 \cdot \mathbf{v}_2 \)?

\( \text{Therefore, } \mathbf{v}_1 \cdot \mathbf{v}_2 = (3)(-4) + (4)(3) = -12 + 12 = 0. \)
